sheets.title: 7Q Explained
sample_rows: One Tree. Seven Lenses. One Physics Example.
Every claim is a tree. We'll take one claim from physics and walk it through all seven questions — showing the classifications, the sub-questions, and what each stage actually produces.
"Mass-energy curves spacetime, and objects follow geodesics through that curvature."

sheets.title: 7Q Reverse
sample_rows: Start with destruction. End with a name. If it survives, it earned the right to exist.
The traditional method starts with a seed and hopes it grows. This method starts with a forest fire and names what's still standing.
Q0 — POSTURE ("You do not arrive already defending.")
unknown → vulnerable  |  "If you can't name how it dies, you can't know if it's alive."
Death Condition 1 — How could this idea die:
→ "These are the ways this idea dies. Watch what happens next."
vulnerable → constrained  |  "A surviving claim that generates nothing downstream explains nothing."
Necessary Consequence 1 — What it MUST produce:
→ "This is not a hypothesis anymore. This is what must follow."
constrained → grounded  |  "The reader sees the foundations — not because you claimed them, but because the structure required them."
Foundation 1 — What must be true for this to stand:
→ "Now you see what holds it up. You decide if those foundations are solid."
grounded → supported  |  "The evidence didn't build the case. It confirmed what survived."
Evidence Unit 1 — What data confirms the survivor:

sheets.title: Evidence Protocol
sample_rows: A claim is only as strong as its evidence — and evidence is only as strong as its explanation. Companion to the 7Q Engine Specification v1.0
THE THREE CHANNELS — Independent axes that multiply, not add
What Current Science Rewards vs. What This Adds
Science already does this well. Measurement, replication, signal detection.
Science systematically avoids this. The Why-Penalty enforces it. ED=0 caps evidence at 50%.
Not "I feel strongly." Does evidence produce consistent downstream effects in lived systems?
COMPLETENESS FORMULA:  CF = (0.5 + 0.5 × ED) × (0.5 + 0.5 × EC)  →  E_final = PS × CF  |  The Why-Penalty: ED=0 caps evidence at 50% no matter how repeatable.
SCENARIO TABLE — How the three channels interact
Full weight earned — all three channels strong
CAPPED — repeatable but blind. Why-Penalty active.

sheets.title: 7Q Framework
sample_rows: Seven questions forward: classify anything. Seven questions reversed: prove anything. Q0: arrive humble or don't arrive at all.
David Lowe | POF 2828 | Theophysics  •  v1.0  •  Obsidian Forge Plugin Spec
Q0 — POSTURE BEFORE INQUIRY  ·  "The inquirer cannot be the ground of inquiry"
Not a question. A precondition. Displayed once at note creation. Cannot be skipped. No AI assist — this is human-only.
User acknowledges: "You do not arrive already decided." Must be checked before Q1 unlocks.
Transformation: undecided → receptive  |  Function: Prevent motivated reasoning before it starts
Q1 — WHAT IS IT?  ·  Identity  ·  "Create the object. Name it. Classify it."
Transformation: undefined → defined  |  Function: Create the object. Name it. Classify it. Prevent category confusion from the start.
Unique identifier for the claim. System generates on creation.
Short clear label summarizing the claim. Max 8 words.
Classify the claim into exactly one type. Determines how evidence and logic apply.
descriptive | causal | ontological | mathematical | mechanistic | predictive | normative
Where the claim sits in the hierarchy of knowledge.
Composed via: [SUBJECT] → [RELATIONSHIP] → [OBJECT] → under [CONDITIONS]. System assembles the sentence.
Builder removes ambiguity by forcing structure
3-6 concise tags capturing core concepts. System suggests from vault.
Relationships to other claims in vault: supports, contradicts, depends_on, equivalent_to.
"Generate a short clear label (max 8 words) summarizing this claim."
"Classify this statement into exactly one of: descriptive, causal, ontological, mathematical, mechanistic, predictive, normative. Return only the word."
"Rewrite into a single precise sentence using: [subject] → [relationship] → [object] (under conditions). Remove all ambiguity. One sentence only."
"Generate 3-6 concise tags capturing core concepts. Return as comma-separated list."
"Given this claim and existing claims in the vault, suggest relationships (supports, contradicts, depends_on, equivalent_to). Return only high-confidence matches."
Q2 — WHERE DOES IT LIVE?  ·  Domain  ·  "Place the object in reality. Anchor it."
Transformation: defined → located  |  Function: Anchor the claim in a domain, scale, and cross-domain status. Isomorphisms are detected here.
The single primary domain this claim belongs to.
physics | biology | psychology | mathematics | philosophy | theology | information | social | computational | moral | consciousness
Any additional domains where this claim also operates. Triggers isomorphism check.
The scale at which this claim operates.
quantum | molecular | neural | individual | social | civilizational | cosmic | universal
Cross-domain structural relationship. Only visible when additional_domains is populated.
SUB-QUESTIONS:  ① Does it appear in more than one domain?  ② If cross-domain: is it analogy or isomorphism? (Can you swap labels and the structure survives?)  ③ At what scale does it operate?

"Identify the primary domain this claim belongs to. Choose from: physics, biology, psychology, mathematics, philosophy, theology, information, social, computational, moral, consciousness. Then identify any additional domains."
"At what scale does this claim operate? Choose from: quantum, molecular, neural, individual, social, civilizational, cosmic, universal. Return one."

"Does this claim appear structurally in more than one domain? If yes, is the mapping an analogy (surface similarity) or isomorphism (structural identity that survives variable substitution)? Return: none, analogy, parallel, or confirmed."
Q3 — WHAT DOES IT SAY?  ·  Assertion  ·  "Force precision. No hedging. The claim commits."
Transformation: located → stated  |  Function: The claim commits to a precise assertion. Generates its own negation for Q7 kill testing.

sheets.title: Truth Score
sample_rows: The user does not fill out a scoring rubric. They answer seven questions. The score falls out of the answers. Not imposed — emergent from structure.
T = w₁·S + w₂·E + w₃·L + w₄·D + w₅·P + w₆·C     |     Normalized to 0–1     |     Weights adjustable (default: equal at 1/6 each)     |     All variables derived from fields user already filled
THE SIX VARIABLES — All Derived from 7Q Fields
How many kill conditions it survived. Alive vs dead vs problematic. Has it been adversarially tested?
Source quality, replication status, significance levels. Tier 1 replicated = maximum.
Internal consistency, proof strength, formal validity. Mathematical proof = maximum.
Foundation stability. Axiom terminus + survive independently = maximum. Circularity = near-zero.
Does it generate correct predictions? Confirmed/total ratio. Zero predictions = inert = 0.
Cross-domain survival. ISO-confirmed across 2+ domains = maximum. Single domain = neutral.
Precision = mathematical or precise → add bonus

sheets.title: Enums & Dropdowns
sample_rows: Every enum, dropdown value, and classification used across the 7Q system. Directly exportable to TypeScript, JSON, YAML, or PostgreSQL enums for plugin development.
Describes what is — observations, measurements, classifications
Asserts X causes Y — mechanism may or may not be specified
Claims about what exists, the nature of being or reality
Explains HOW something works — the internal process
Forecasts future states or unobserved values
Claims about what SHOULD be — ethical, prescriptive
Axiom, postulate, or definition — the ground floor
Theorem, corollary, or hypothesis — built from foundations
Boundary condition — limits rather than asserts
Evidence bundle — backs another claim, not standalone
Bridge or relationship — links two other claims
Physical laws, forces, particles, fields, spacetime
God, revelation, sacred texts, divine action
Awareness, qualia, experience, the hard problem
Neurons, synapses, brain circuits, neural networks
Nations, cultures, historical epochs, global systems
The entire universe, fundamental laws, scale-independent
Surface similarity across domains — labels overlap but structure may not
Structural similarity across domains — untested whether structure truly matches
Structural identity confirmed — variable substitution preserves the claim
